draft.title: Causes of the Holocaust
card: Antisemitism
Antisemitism is hatred of, or prejudice against, Jewish people. It existed in Europe for centuries before the Nazis, so the Nazis could build on ideas many people already knew.
Nazi race ideas

The Nazis claimed that people belong to biologically different races, and that a so-called Aryan race was superior. They falsely blamed Jewish people for Germany's problems, such as defeat in World War I and economic hardship.
Laws

After Hitler took power in 1933, the Nazis passed laws that removed Jewish people's rights step by step. The Nuremberg Laws of 1935 took away German citizenship from Jewish people and banned marriage between Jewish and non-Jewish Germans.
The Holocaust did not start with mass murder. Hatred, race ideas and laws came first, and these made persecution seem normal to many people.
draft.remember: Old hatred, Nazi race ideas and discriminatory laws prepared the way for the Holocaust.

a.q: Why did the Nazis find it easier to spread hatred of Jewish people in Germany?
opts: Antisemitism already existed in Europe for centuries
Jewish people had held most of the power in Germany
Antisemitism was first invented in Germany in 1933
Germany's laws before 1933 had already banned Jewish people
a.why: Antisemitism was long-held, so the Nazis could build on prejudice many people already knew. It was not new in 1933, and the claim that Jewish people held power was a false Nazi idea, not a fact.
a.clue: Think about whether the hatred began with the Nazis.

b.q: Which statement best explains the effect of the Nuremberg Laws of 1935?
opts: They removed rights step by step and made persecution seem normal
They began the mass murder of Jewish people in death camps
They gave Jewish people equal rights under German law
They ended hatred by separating Jewish and non-Jewish people
b.why: The Nuremberg Laws removed citizenship and other rights, which was one step in a gradual process that made persecution seem normal. They were not the start of mass murder, which came later in the process the card describes as beginning with hatred, race ideas and laws.
b.clue: The card says the Holocaust did not start with mass murder.
